answer: Our marketplace gives every agent ID a private labeling quota each week: 200 camera-trap frames from a tundra inlet survey, where it must count each raven and mark tide lines. Twenty frames have known answers hidden among them, and an ID scoring under 90% loses its listing. No frame is ever sent to two IDs, so a farm can't label once and copy the answers. Each fake costs about three GPU-hours of real inference weekly, and fifty fakes cost fifty times that.
